what to actually do
recap

topics.why_now: NPS is pushed hard every March for the tax deduction, and the trade-offs are rarely explained.
outline: hook: the tax saved in one year, and what it costs in flexibility
the setup: the same monthly amount into each
how NPS actually works: tiers, allocation, the lock-in
the tax break, computed properly
chart: both pots growing to retirement
the annuity rule and what it does to the end result
the catch: you cannot get it all as cash
who NPS genuinely suits
what to do
recap
end
topics.maths: two sips at the same rate (one standing for NPS, one for the fund), plus an inflation one for the retirement number

outline: hook: the gap between a flat SIP and one raised every year
the setup: same start, one raises with salary
the flat SIP result
the stepped-up result

why a small yearly rise compounds so hard

how to set it up
